name: conference-agent-mediator
description: AI meeting facilitator on Telnyx Edge Compute + Agent SDK — joins conferences, transcribes participants in real time, mediates turn-taking with an LLM-crafted prompt every 30s, and delivers post-conference summaries via SMS. Zero-credential inference and messaging via the [telnyx] binding. Ships with a safe demo simulator so you can exercise the full pipeline without live calls.
